title: Ethyl Cyanide On Titan: Spectroscopic Detection and Mapping Using Alma
question: Is gas-phase ethyl cyanide (C2H5CN) present in Titan's atmosphere, and what are its vertical and spatial distributions compared with HC3N, CH3CN and CH3CCH?

what.value: Titan temperature profile from Cassini CIRS and HASI

evidence.quote: The atmospheric temperature profile was generated from a combination of Cassini CIRS and HASI measurements

what.value: Line parameters and partition functions from JPL catalog

evidence.quote: Spectral line parameters and partition functions were taken from the JPL catalog.
scaled to match the Butler-JPL-Horizons 2010 Titan flux model (see ALMA Memo #594)

recipe.method: Archive-calibrated data flux-scaled to Titan model, uvcontsub, clean per channel, Doppler-shift to Titan rest frame

recipe.goal: extract disk-integrated spectra and identify lines
recipe.method: Integrate cubes in circular region radius 1.1''; assign with Splatalogue, CDMS, JPL
Sum strongest lines per species (six C2H5CN lines 223.9-224.1 GHz) and overlay on continuum
Line-by-line radiative transfer least-squares fits of step and gradient abundance profiles to 223.9-224.2 GHz lines
key_parameters: step z_c 100-400 km; gradient model reference altitude 292 km, slope as fraction of scale height
assumptions: Profiles do not vary with latitude/longitude; Lorentzian half-width 0.075 cm-1 atm-1 at 296 K, exponent 0.50; model atmosphere to 1000 km

evidence.quote: The best-fitting abundance at $z_r$ was found to be $1.3 \pm 0.4$ ppb
with a retrieved fractional scale height of $f_H = 4.6 \pm 1.1$

answer_key.quantity: Column density range for good-fit models

evidence.quote: The models that fit the data well have values in the range $(1-5)\times10^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$.

answer_key.quantity: Peak S/N of maps C2H5CN, HC3N, CH3CN, CH3CCH

not_stated_but_needed: uvcontsub line-free channels and fit order
Specific aerosol and isotopologue abundance values
Noise estimation for fit uncertainties and the 3 sigma line detection
Exact lines summed for the C2H5CN map
score_reason: Public archival data and a clear description of imaging, but retrieval inputs and several settings are not given.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, a mostly specified recipe and numeric results (column densities and abundances).
